description.narrative: The Project is expected to contribute to the development of health systems in Cote dIvoire as new and specialized treatments are provided. It is expected that the Project facilities will be among the first to introduce some of the Project targeted treatments in Cote dIvoire. The Project will allow doctors to develop skills in new types of treatments.

The proposed IFC investment seeks to support the Farah Group, a leading healthcare services group in Côte dIvoire (CIV), in setting up an Oncology Center and an Eye Care Center in Abidjan (the Project). The project is expected to be supported by the IDA20 Private Sector Window Local Currency Facility (IDA PSW LCF) as described in the Blended Finance Section.
